title: Keep in-delivery claims live and enforce closure on merge
body:
Tracker judge 2026-10-29: when a delivery branch closes its task (as ADR 0015 asks), the lead claim expires and krn task ready lists the task again until the PR merges (t-8zvy7c5 during #135); merged PRs #133 and #134 left their tasks open on main, so claim --next would hand out finished work.
Acceptance: a claim whose worktree closed the task stays live as in delivery until origin/main shows the task closed; krn task check refuses a branch whose commits carry Ticket: <id> while that task is open on the branch; observers RED on base and GREEN on head.
